sentences.text: The relevant provision is paragraph 261(2)(ii) of the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, which says a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on floating-rate loans for business purpose to Micro and Small Enterprises with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.

missing.searched: Checked the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paragraphs 260 and 261 for applicability; the code findings did not provide the loan sanction date.
